# Portfolio

> Official portfolio of inbo, a Roblox Luau developer documenting multiplayer games and gameplay systems.

Canonical site: https://inbodev.com/
Projects: https://inbodev.com/#projects
Skills: https://inbodev.com/#skills
Pricing: https://inbodev.com/#pricing
Verified client reviews: https://inbodev.com/#testimonials
Contact: https://inbodev.com/#contact

The portfolio includes 11 detailed project case studies covering server-authoritative combat, multiplayer round systems, data persistence, UI, movement, physics, economy, and progression systems. Each case study includes a demonstration video, technical summary, and technologies used.

Primary technologies: Roblox, Luau, Rojo, Git, ProfileService, DataStore, RemoteEvents, server-authoritative validation.
